evidence: Rewrites BIP32 derivation path utilities in src/util/bip32.cpp and src/util/bip32.h, introducing KeyPath and KeyPathElement abstractions.
rationale: Introduces robust KeyPath and KeyPathElement utility abstractions to replace raw std::vector<uint32_t> derivation paths. While it touches shared BIP32 infrastructure across the node, the change is primarily an internal refactor driven by descriptor subsystem needs.
